video_title: Joakim Noah Faces His Past in France With Yannick & Tony Parker | NOMAD | Episode 10

quotes.speaker: Yannick Noah
quotes.summary_phrase: Yannick Noah on the sacrifices made to become a tennis champion
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know where I was going to. Because you know the first 10 years when you stop playing and practicing you don't get paid.

text_blocks.speaker: Yannick Noah
text_blocks.text: I didn't know where I was going to. Because you know the first 10 years when you stop playing and practicing you don't get paid. You better be passionate about it.

text_blocks.speaker: Joakim Noah
text_blocks.text: But you're talking about sacrifice. I took a different road from most of the people, which is difficult because they sometimes like a lonely road.

quotes.verbatim_original_language:
Yannick Noah: Je ne savais pas où j'allais. Parce que tu sais les 10 premières années quand tu arrêtes de jouer et de t'entraîner, tu n'es pas payé. Tu ferais mieux d'être passionné par ça.
Joakim Noah: Mais tu parles de sacrifice. J'ai pris une route différente de la plupart des gens, ce qui est difficile parce que c'est parfois une route solitaire.

quotes.speaker: Yannick Noah
quotes.summary_phrase: Yannick Noah on his mission to win the French Open as a Black man
quotes.excerpt: I'll be the first black guy winning the French Open. You see me as black, let's do it this way.

text_blocks.speaker: Yannick Noah
text_blocks.text: And that thing was like, I'll be the first black guy winning the French Open. You see me as black, let's do it this way. I'll be the first.

text_blocks.speaker: Joakim Noah
text_blocks.text: How hard is it watching your kids grow up playing sports?

quotes.verbatim_original_language:
Yannick Noah: Et cette chose était comme, je serai le premier noir à gagner Roland-Garros. Tu me vois comme noir, faisons-le de cette façon. Je serai le premier.
Joakim Noah: À quel point est-ce difficile de regarder ses enfants grandir en faisant du sport ?

quotes.speaker: Oxmo Puccino
quotes.summary_phrase: Oxmo Puccino on the dual identity of French-Malian athletes
quotes.excerpt: If you look at history, you'll understand exactly where we stand today without questioning our very presence.

text_blocks.speaker: Oxmo Puccino
text_blocks.text: If you look at history, you'll understand exactly where we stand today without questioning our very presence or why we have this dual nationality and this dual culture. In other words, I had to face it head-on right away, to confront, rather belatedly, questions to which the system offered no answers.

text_blocks.speaker: Joakim Noah
text_blocks.text: I know my history, my roots.

quotes.verbatim_original_language:
Oxmo Puccino: Si tu te penches sur l'histoire, tu comprends exactement où nous en sommes aujourd'hui pleinement sans te poser aucune question de notre présence ou de pourquoi cette binationalité, cette double culture. En d'autres termes, moi j'ai dû tout de suite me confronter à des questions auxquelles le système n'apportait aucune réponse.
Joakim Noah: Je connais mon histoire, mes racines.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker on his regret about Joakim Noah's French national team career
quotes.excerpt: But if I have one regret in my career, it's that Joakim didn't play for the French national team more often.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Parker
text_blocks.text: But if I have one regret in my career, it's that Joakim didn't play for the French national team more often, because unfortunately he had injuries that kept us from becoming Olympic champions. Because I'm convinced that if Joe hadn't gotten injured in 2012, I think we could have won a gold medal.

text_blocks.speaker: Joakim Noah
text_blocks.text: Joe is one of the best players I've ever played with in my career.

quotes.verbatim_original_language:
Tony Parker: Mais si j'ai un seul regret dans ma carrière, c'est que Joakim il soit pas plus venu en équipe de France, parce que malheureusement il a eu des blessures qui nous ont empêché d'être champions olympiques. Parce que moi je suis persuadé que si Joe il s'était pas blessé en 2012, je pense qu'on aurait pu gagner une médaille d'or.
Joakim Noah: Joe c'est un des meilleurs joueurs avec qui j'ai joué dans ma carrière.

quotes.speaker: Tony Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Parker defends Joakim Noah's commitment to the French national team
quotes.excerpt: So for people to say that you didn't have love for France, I'm the first one that lived it.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Parker
text_blocks.text: So for people to say that you didn't have love for France, I'm the first one that lived it. It is not true at all. So I'm going to close that chapter, but people have to know that you have a lot of love for France and you did everything you can to play for the national team. And that's all I can ask as a teammate and your brother.

quotes.verbatim_original_language:
Tony Parker: Donc pour les gens de dire que tu n'avais pas d'amour pour la France, je suis le premier à l'avoir vécu. Ce n'est pas vrai du tout. Donc je vais fermer ce chapitre, mais les gens doivent savoir que tu as beaucoup d'amour pour la France et que tu as fait tout ce que tu peux pour jouer pour l'équipe nationale. Et c'est tout ce que je peux demander en tant que coéquipier et ton frère.
Joakim Noah: Ça signifie beaucoup.
